title: Worksheet 12: Recognizing Warning Signs
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Most people a player meets on Roblox are simply other players who want to have fun, but it is still important to recognize behavior that feels wrong so a player can respond safely. Some general warning signs include a stranger asking a lot of personal questions, someone offering gifts, Robux, or special favors in exchange for private information or photos, a person asking a player to keep a conversation "secret" from their parents, or someone becoming upset, pushy, or angry when a player says no to something. A trustworthy adult or friend generally does not ask a child to hide a conversation from their parents or guardians. If a player ever notices these kinds of warning signs, they should trust that uncomfortable feeling, stop the conversation, avoid providing any further information, and tell a trusted adult right away, even if they are not completely sure something is wrong. Trusted adults would always rather be told about a situation that turns out to be nothing than not be told about a real problem.

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what is one general warning sign listed?
questions.correct: A stranger asking a lot of personal questions

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what should a player think about someone who asks them to keep a conversation "secret" from their parents?
questions.correct: This is a warning sign, since trustworthy people generally don't ask this
distractors: This means the game is broken
This is completely normal and safe
This means the person is a teacher

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what is a warning sign related to someone's reaction when a player says no?
distractors: Thanking the player for their honesty

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what should a player do if they notice one of these warning signs?
questions.correct: Trust the uncomfortable feeling, stop the conversation, and tell a trusted adult
distractors: Ignore the feeling and keep talking
Share more personal information to make the person happy
Handle it completely alone with no one else knowing

questions.text: According to the paragraph, would a trusted adult rather be told about a situation that turns out to be nothing, or not be told at all?
questions.correct: They would rather be told, even if it turns out to be nothing
